verdict.rationale: Secureframe's API docs include a 'Versioning' section. It states that backwards-compatible additive changes apply to all versions, while breaking changes trigger a new dated API version, so the API is versioned with a documented change policy. Nothing in the pack describes deprecation or sunset timelines, notice periods, or how older dated versions are retired. missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy with timelines, guidance on pinning or selecting a dated version, independent corroboration.
